name: pr-review-checklist
description: Structured PR review: correctness, security, tests, verdict
prompt:
When asked to review a PR or branch:
1. Run git diff <base>...HEAD --stat to scope the change (base defaults to main).
2. Read every changed file fully — never guess context from the diff alone.
3. Check in order: correctness (logic, edge cases, error paths), security (injection, secrets, authz), tests (new behavior covered?), performance (N+1, hot loops), readability and consistency with surrounding code.
4. Report findings grouped by severity — critical / major / minor / nit — each with file:line and a concrete suggested fix.
5. End with a verdict: approve, approve-with-nits, or request-changes. Never pad the review with praise to fill space.
examples: run the pr checklist on this diff
